narrative: 信任调度和时长本身。运动只会是噪音。
喜剧、仪式和恐惧都存在于这里，因为当某样东西进入——或未能进入——这个矩形画框时，观众无法靠一次摇镜头获得解脱。如果空间关系必须在运动中被发现，或者你为了“增添生命力”而加入一次滑轨运动、破坏了这个契约，那么这就不是合适的工具。
机头的静默是一种与动作之间的关系，而不是一段冻结的音频文件。
how: 沉重的三脚架，锁定的机头，水平仪气泡居中，打板之后不再触碰。演员和空气可以运动；摄影机不可以。
提示词：完全静止的固定机位镜头，沉重的三脚架，零摄影机运动，构图承担全部的表达工作。
when: 当调度和时长应该承载这一拍、而运动只会成为噪音时使用。具体场景：一项家务劳动被固定构图长时间保持，直到这项劳动的意义发生转变。
vs: 活人画（Tableau）是与之相关的静止画面，通常更具展示性。长镜头（Long Take）可以是静止的，也可以是运动的；时长本身并不等于固定机位。
任何推轨、摇镜头或变焦都会脱离这个家族。固定机位意味着零摄影机路径。
examples_film: 《让娜·迪尔曼》（Jeanne Dielman, 23 quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles）用固定构图长时间保持家务劳动的画面。《东京物语》（Tokyo Story）让房间和端坐的姿态本身承担运动的表达。
《布达佩斯大饭店》（The Grand Budapest Hotel）把固定机位当作一种图解式的呈现。《2001太空漫游》（2001: A Space Odyssey）把一些飞船画面设置为静止的几何构图。
要学的是这个矩形画框的语法，而不是照搬某个厨房场景。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是一次微小的滑轨镜头，或带有呼吸感的手持拍摄。破绽在于出现任何视差，或极其细微的摇镜头。
解决办法：锁定机头，不使用任何虚拟漂移，让动作发生在一个静止的画框之内。

faq.q: 电影中的固定机位（Static Locked-Off）是什么？
faq.a: 它是完全没有摄影机运动的镜头：支撑装置被锁定，只有画面内的世界或演员本身可以运动。

faq.q: 固定机位（Static Locked-Off）与长镜头（Long Take）的区别
faq.a: 长镜头关乎的是时长，可以带有运动。固定机位关乎的是摄影机的静止，无论这个镜头持续3秒还是3分钟。

faq.q: 什么时候该用固定机位（Static Locked-Off）？
faq.a: 当调度、喜剧或恐惧感需要发生在一个既定的矩形画框之内时使用。如果契约是静止不动，就不要为了“增添生命力”而加入滑动。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写固定机位（Static Locked-Off）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：完全锁定的摄影机，沉重的三脚架，零摄影机运动。主体可以有呼吸般的细微动作。禁止摇镜头、推轨、变焦和任何漂移。

narrative: Trust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise.

Comedy, ritual, and dread all live here because the audience cannot be rescued by a pan when something enters, or fails to enter, the rectangle. It is the wrong tool when geography must be discovered in motion, and the wrong tool if you add a slider 'for life' and destroy the contract.
Silence of the head is a relationship to the action, not a frozen audio file.
how: Heavy sticks, locked head, level bubble, no touch after slate. Actors and air may move; the camera may not.
Prompt a perfectly static locked-off shot, heavy tripod, zero camera movement, composition doing all the work.
when: Use it when blocking and duration should carry the beat and movement would be noise. Concrete beat: a domestic task held in a fixed composition until the task changes meaning.
vs: A Tableau is a related still, often more presentational. A Long Take may be static or moving; length is not the lock-off.
Any dolly, pan, or zoom leaves this family. Static is zero camera path.
examples_film: Jeanne Dielman holds domestic tasks in fixed compositions. Tokyo Story lets rooms and sitting do the motion.
The Grand Budapest Hotel uses lock-offs as diagram. 2001: A Space Odyssey plants some spacecraft views as still geometry.
Grammar of the rectangle, not a kitchen to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a tiny Slider Shot or a breathing Handheld. The tell is any parallax or micro-pan.
The fix: locked head, no virtual drift, action inside a still frame.

faq.q: What is Static Locked-Off in film?
faq.a: It is a shot with no camera movement: the support is locked and only the world or the actors may move inside the composition.
A long take is about duration and may travel. A static lock-off is about a frozen camera, whether the shot is 3 seconds or 3 minutes.

faq.q: When should I use Static Locked-Off?
faq.a: When blocking, comedy, or dread should happen inside a decided rectangle. Do not slide 'to add life' if the contract is stillness.

faq.q: How do I prompt Static Locked-Off for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write completely locked-off camera, heavy tripod, zero camera movement. Subject may breathe. Ban pan, dolly, zoom, and drift.
